citation: Mousavi, S. M., Sheng, Y., Zhu, W., and Beroza, G. C. (2019). STEAD dataset. IEEE Access. doi:10.1109/ACCESS.2019.2947848.
processing: STEAD source waveforms are detrended, demeaned, and resampled at 100 Hz. This app preserves the supplied samples, rounds to four decimal places, and converts HDF5 to JSON. E, N, Z component order follows the STEAD documentation. Amplitudes remain instrument counts; no instrument response correction is applied. Manual arrival indices are cross-checked against both CSV and HDF5 metadata.
